fde-sdlc-business-requirement/lab-1-disc.summary: Role-play sponsor discovery and draft the one-page BRD for Ask IT.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body:
- Discovery workshop and BRD draft.
- In pairs, one participant plays the IT sponsor and the other the FDE.
- Capture the problem, users, source documents, restricted content, desired outcomes and constraints, then write a one-page BRD.

sections.heading: Done when
sections.body: The BRD identifies target users, problem statement, in-scope/out-of-scope items, data sources, measurable acceptance criteria, assumptions and open questions.
